spans.label: DepositWitness struct fields

spans.label: DepositWitnessTarget struct fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. The target struct is represented by the gate predicate over the same fields.

spans.label: DepositWitness::new
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. `new` assembles, verifies and returns the arguments unchanged.

spans.label: DepositWitness::verify (index range, opening, recipient binding)
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Check order and error precedence are modelled; the opening is an opaque callback.

spans.label: DepositWitnessTarget::new (allocation, range checks, opening, recipient connect)
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Range checks are a declarative table; the recipient `connect` is an equality premise.

spans.label: DepositWitnessTarget::set_witness
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Only the order in which fields are written is modelled.

boundaries.name: merkle-opening
boundaries.obligation: IncrementalMerkleProof::verify over the deposit tree and its target counterpart are opaque decision callbacks.

boundaries.name: poseidon-hash
boundaries.obligation: The recipient derivation and the deposit nullifier both call an opaque Poseidon callback; nullifier uniqueness statements carry an explicit injectivity premise on the compared pair.

boundaries.name: deposit-leaf-layout
boundaries.obligation: Deposit and DepositTarget word layouts are transcribed from src/common/deposit.rs by hand, not derived from that file's own model.

boundaries.name: merkle-index-truncation
boundaries.obligation: MerkleEnv.truncates is transcribed from BitPath::pop rather than proved about the Rust code.

boundaries.name: plonky2-gate-lowering
boundaries.obligation: No proof that DepositWitnessGates corresponds to the constraints DepositWitnessTarget::new emits, including the U63 63-bit range check.
